description: Send a transactional SMS via Brevo (POST /transactionalSMS/sms). This SENDS to outside recipients immediately — confirm recipients and content with the human first. Required: sender (max 11 alphanumeric or 15 digits), recipient (international number, e.g. 4915112345678), content. Optional: type (transactional|marketing), tag, webUrl, unicodeEnabled, organisationPrefix.

organisationPrefix.description: Organisation name prefixed to the SMS text

recipient.description: Recipient number in international format without plus sign

sender.description: Sender name, max 11 alphanumeric characters or 15 digits

tag.description: Tag for grouping the SMS in Brevo

unicodeEnabled.description: Allow unicode characters in the SMS text

webUrl.description: Webhook URL Brevo notifies about the SMS status

name: send_brevo_sms
